text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a gain; a gain relative to my cost does not show whether selling is best now.","I should judge each holding by its current prospects and the portfolio as a whole, not treat it as a separate account or let my purchase price dictate my decision.","Past price changes do not predict future changes, so I should avoid acting on short-term moves and trade only when I have a reason beyond the comfort of doing nothing."]}
